hooks.command: R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"); [ -f "$R/hot.md" ] && { echo '=== hot.md (recent wiki context, read silently, do not announce) ==='; cat "$R/hot.md"; } || true

R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && [ -f "$R/hot.md" ] && F=$( { git -C "$R" diff --name-only HEAD; git -C "$R" ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } 2>/dev/null ) && ! printf '%s\n' "$F" | grep -qx 'hot.md' && printf '%s\n' "$F" | grep -qE '^(daily/|weekly/|decisions/|knowledge/|people/|raw/|plans/|INDEX\.md|log\.md|lessons\.md)|/initiatives/' && echo 'HOT_CACHE_REMINDER: The wiki was modified in this session but hot.md may be out of sync. If appropriate, update hot.md (overwrite completely, ~500 words, format: Last Updated / Key Recent Facts / Recent Changes / Active Threads / Open Patterns) before the user ends the session. If /end-session or /daily-log was already run, this update already happened — do not repeat it.' || true
